hero.title: From Raw Hide to Finished Leather, In-House
hero.intro: Every product begins at our state-of-the-art in-house tannery, where we process up to 200 hides daily through wet-blue and wet-white tanning. Operating under the same roof as our finishing and manufacturing units, we ensure seamless quality control from raw hide to Finished Products.
hero.imageAlt: Hides drying at the Kings International in-house tannery, Kanpur

initiativesSection.heading: Full control, from raw hide to finished leather.

items.title: 200 Hides a Day
items.body: Our Kanpur tannery processes up to 200 hides daily, giving us the raw material base for every finished leather and leather goods category we manufacture.

items.title: Wet-Blue & Wet-White Tanning
items.body: Chrome and chrome-free tanning processes run in parallel, letting us match the tanning method to the end use - garments, bags, belts or saddlery.

items.title: Full Grading & Selection
items.body: Every hide is graded and selected before it reaches finishing, so batch-to-batch consistency in colour, temper and thickness is controlled at the source, not after the fact.

items.title: REACH-Compliant Chemicals
items.body: Tanning and finishing chemicals are REACH-compliant throughout, supporting both product safety and the facility's environmental compliance standards.

commitmentsSection.heading: Vertical integration starts here.
items: No dependency on third-party pre-tanned stock - consistency is controlled from the raw hide onward.
Direct traceability from hide intake through to finished leather.
Tanning capacity and finishing lines managed on the same site as manufacturing.
Almost 50 years of in-house tanning experience, since 1977.
